answer_1.quote: To cover several task categories, we use six datasets suited to benefit from retrieval and finetuning. We select Natural Questions (NQ) , TriviaQA (TQA) , NarrativeQA (NQA)  and Qasper  for document question answering, QuALITY (Pang et al., 2021) for multiple-choice question answering, and QMSum  for query-based summarization.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers for question answering tasks and summaries for summarization tasks.

answer_2.quote: Following the official metrics, we use F1 score for evaluating document QA, exact match for multiple-choice QA and the geometric mean of ROUGE-1/2/L
